input.summary:
P0 shared porch furnished in parts/room-5.mjs: two dark-oak rockers (stairs, backs to the house wall) at x3 and x8 facing the lane, a barrel side table with a standing lantern at each end (x2, x9), and a hanging lantern over the lane at (5,5,8). Doorway cells x4/x7 and lane cells x5..6 at z8 stay clear.
make.sh writes a whole build.nbt with no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE lines for this part. Room check: FIT OK, light min 10 with 0 dark and 0 dim cells.
Walk verdict still says UNREACHABLE because the steps and deck are fittings/shell B, which are stubs in this copy; the interior path (steps gap x5..6 to z8, then to both doorway cells) is clear by reading the grid, but not verified by the tool.
left: Walk verdict not yet confirmed: `mcd room` reports 0 of 20 floor cells reachable because the front steps (x5..6 z6) and the porch deck (y2, z7..8) are built by other parts that are stubs in this copy. Re-run after the merge; the lane runs in through the rail gap x5..6 at z7 to z8.
Rockers are hand-placed dark_oak_stairs facing south (back to the house wall), not rocker(): the helper's back trapdoor would need a wall cell behind the seat, which is the house wall here.
Shutters at x1 and x10 z8 (fittings) would close the side ends of the porch; this part keeps off those cells and does not depend on them.
plan.md and elements.md have no checklist line for interior furnishing of this room, so nothing was ticked.

waste.what: Checking light and walkability by trial: I placed lanterns, then moved them after each make.sh, to clear the dim west and east ends of the porch.
waste.tool: `mcd room` lamp suggestions should be able to name the cell and the light source in one run; a dry-run light preview would avoid the rebuilds.

waste.what: Working out the rocker geometry by hand: the rocker() helper puts its back trapdoor behind the seat, so a seat against a house wall has no room for it, and I had to hand-place dark_oak_stairs with the facing reversed.
waste.tool: rocker() needs an option for a seat against a wall with no trapdoor back (or a stair-only seat variant).

waste.what: Writing the furniture row by hand: each row needed character-by-character column counting (the porch's x1..10 row) to get barrels, stairs and lanterns to the right cells; I got one column wrong (lantern at x8 instead of x9), which made a floating-decor fault.
waste.cost: 2 wrong layouts fixed, about 4 minutes of counting
waste.tool: `mcd plan` could print the column index above each row and the rows as an x-labelled grid, so the layers() text lines up without counting.

companions.task: Confirm the porch lantern plan (two standing lanterns on the barrels, one hanging under the eave) against the final merged build's light map before the roof and rail go in.
Check that the front steps at x5..6 z6 meet the deck at y2 and the rail gap at x5..6 z7, so the porch walk verdict passes after the merge.
